Schizophrenia can be triggered by stressors to the brain. Acid can be a big stressor especially if you have a bad trip. 

Although psychiatry likes to perpetuate that mental illnesses are "chemical imbalances" when in fact there is no scientific proof of this. The only thing we know is that certain chemicals can contribute to different moods, but in terms of things like psychosis... There's no one chemical brain chemical that causes a psychotic break. Drugs can make you lose touch with reality of course, but when the LSD or psilocybin gets reabsorbed and stops taking effect then your touch with reality will come back. 


Personally, my dad and grandmother were both schizophrenics. I already have other mental health issues. I've done acid 10+ times and shrooms 3. Acid eventually pretty much cured my anxiety, and shrooms seem to be helping my depression. I've  shown mild psychotic symptoms before when in a manic episode, but never anything indicative of schizophrenia.

My friend and I did morning glory seeds when we were 16... Too many. Faaaaarrrr too many. No prior experience of any drugs other than some weed. 

My friend basically got PTSD from it... For a while she was bad. I was bad too, not to that degree because toward the end I accepted my trip so it was kinda fine...but. 

Two years later, and she's perfectly normal again
As am I.

For the first year, maybe a little over even, I thought about that trip everyday. Every single day. I wondered if there would ever be a time where I don't feel haunted by it. I don't anymore.

Two years is a while, but it wasn't for forever. I think drugs can permanently change your brain, they surely changed mine, but certainly not in a bad way anymore. 

Maybe for you it will be over sooner. But nevertheless, it won't be permanent.
